verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful public API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, an interactive playground and an MCP integration, but no evidence shows official SDK client libraries in any language. A raw REST API and an OpenAPI document are developer building blocks from which a user could generate a client, not first-party SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
